[h1][b]Hi Bankers![/b][/h1]

We’re incredibly grateful to the 20,000+ players who have already added Banker Simulator: Prologue to their libraries thank you for your support!

We've added a Feedback Button to the game, so you can easily share your thoughts and help us improve the experience. Your suggestions mean a lot to us and will directly shape the future of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529831/1f7fc62b0fd678bece29d23f990f3dbf2c2bdccc.png[/img]

[h2][b]Add to Your Wishlist! ✅ [/b][/h2] 

Add our game to your wishlist to stay updated and follow our development progress. Be the first to hear about new updates and announcements. Your support means the world to us!


[h3][b]Wishlist Now![/b][/h3]
